title: Awesome DuckDB
by: David Gasquez and contributors, on GitHub
summary: A community-curated list of more than 400 DuckDB links: client APIs, core and community extensions, BI and ETL tools built on DuckDB (grouped by commercial, open core and open source), WebAssembly and SQL clients, plus talks, podcasts, blog posts and books. Use it to find what already exists around DuckDB; entries arrive by pull request with one-line descriptions, so judge each project yourself.
